_comment: A neutral, multi-step effectful demo: Cart -> Review -> Paid, with a guard branch and a multi-key context (the case turnstile can't exercise). Structure only; guards/reducers/validators are hand-written per language and bound by name.

transitions.guardMessage: A payable order needs items, a positive total, and a receipt.

differential._comment: Feeds the exhaustive cross-runtime differential corpus. `samples` are representative inputs per trigger (a no-input case is always added). `seeds` are representative valid contexts for states a trigger cannot reach (items/total arrive via autosave, so Review/Paid are not BFS-reachable from the initial Cart).
